تستدركون (form X)
# تَسْتَدْرِكُونَ (tastadrikūna) /tas.tad.ri.kuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَدْرَكَ (istadraka)
# تُسْتَدْرَكُونَ (tustadrakūna) /tus.tad.ra.kuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَدْرَكَ (istadraka)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
